## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale and spiritual-looking young woman. She is also described as being fair and golden.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla Grant is a pale, spiritual-looking young woman. Despite her delicate appearance, she is full of fun, mischief, and pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She later joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on a spring picnic walk where they discovered the flower-filled garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md). Afterwards, she sent [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a letter explaining that author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) had sprained her ankle, preventing an intended visit; however, Priscilla later unexpectedly arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), enjoying a pleasant dinner and woodland walk hosted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). The following year, Priscilla greeted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) and moved into a new boarding house with her. While registering at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), the pair met and quickly befriended vibrant fellow student [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). During their second term, Priscilla joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in searching for a house to rent for the upcoming school year, successfully arranging to lease Patty's Place from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), +38 more_

## Quotes

> "I’m so sorry, but I’m afraid we won’t get up to Green Gables at all now, for by the time Aunty’s ankle is well she will have to go back to Toronto. She has to be there by a certain date."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063)

> "It would be too good to be true. Fairy tales don’t happen nowadays. I won’t hope, Anne. The disappointment would be too awful to bear. They’re sure to want more for it than we can afford. Remember, it’s on Spofford Avenue."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Friend P31](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0031)

> "This cake is now what you might call a flat failure. And the cushion is likewise ruined. Never tell me that Friday isn’t unlucky."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P35](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0035)

> “I like her, too,” said Priscilla, decidedly. “She talks as much about boys as Ruby Gillis does. But it always enrages or sickens me to hear Ruby, whereas I just wanted to laugh good-naturedly at Phil. Now, what is the why of that?”
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Lady P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070)

> “Little did I think the day would ever come when I’d be glad of the sight of a Sloane,” said Priscilla, as they crossed the campus, “but I’d welcome Charlie’s goggle eyes almost ecstatically. At least, they’d be familiar eyes.”
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Lady P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) formed an intimate friendship as students together at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Their bond continues through social outings, such as spring walks and picnics in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), as well as joint visits with guests like Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). Later, they transition to college life together when they register at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and secure housing together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +30 more_

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is Priscilla's aunt, and the two travel and visit acquaintances together.
